'''Ronald Fonck Mops''' is a [[Light]] deck by [[Ronald Fonck]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ls128.htm Mops], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010228002939/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ls128.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
